text: Colon biopsy, descending colon. DIAGNOSIS: Adenocarcinoma, moderately differentiated, conventional type. Immunohistochemistry: CK20 positive, CDX2 positive, CK7 negative. Mismatch Repair (MMR) proteins: MLH1 preserved, MSH2 preserved, MSH6 preserved, PMS2 preserved (Microsatellite Stable - MSS). Molecular testing: KRAS mutation detected (G12D in exon 2). BRAF V600E: Not detected. NRAS: Wild type. COMMENT: The findings are consistent with colorectal adenocarcinoma. MSS status and KRAS mutation present. Not a candidate for anti-EGFR therapy due to KRAS mutation.
